Name: YACS - Yet Another Cooking Skill
Author: MoonSlime
Description:
[size=3]YACS is a remix / Redux (what ever you want to call it) of ideas from [u]CookingSkill[/u] by Spacechase and [u]For the Love of Cooking[/u] By Blueberry, tossed into a pan and baked by me in the oven. It'll have similarities to those two but yet differences. I would say my mod will sit in the middle of those two, as it adds it's own custom recipes and gives level up rewards but isn't a complete overhaul to the food system. 

﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/3qxSqCb.png[/img]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Gain EXP from any food you cook.[/size]
[*][size=3]Home-Cooked foods now have a bonus gain on friendship equal to 10% of their edibility.[/size]
[*][size=3]Ingredient input quality now affects Cooking food output quality.[/size]
[*][size=3]As you level up, gain access to many new recipes. These recipes all have buffs to them. [/size]
[*][size=3]Choose professions that increase gold gained from foods you cook, increase the power of the buffs you cook, or even gain random buffs from eating.[/size]
[*][size=3]Some foods even have cross mod buffs![/size]
[*][size=3]Cross-Mod Gift Tastes for every item in the mod, for SVE and RSV. [/size]
[/list][size=3]
How EXP works
[list]
[*][size=3]Gain 2 EXP every time you cook something[/size]
[*][size=3]Gain 50% of the item's edibility as bonus exp for the first 10 crafting.[/size]
[*][size=3]So Cooking a pizza will give 32 exp for the first 10 crafts totaling 320 exp. Then will only give 2.[/size]
[*][size=3]This is to encourage crafting many different foods and can be adjusted in the configs.[/size]
[*][size=3]It takes crafting 7427 fried eggs to reach level 10 cooking if you just cook fried eggs. Get them chickens laying![/size]
[/list][/size][size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LGFY8Nd.png[/img]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Level up Bonus: +3% edibility from foods you cooked. Longer duration and stronger effects from the professions below.[/size]
[/list][size=3][list]
[*]Level 5a: Cook - Cooked meals have a chance to have a higher quality.[list]
[*]Level 10a1: Caterer - When cooking, chance to receive double the recipe based on twice your cooking bonus
[*]Level 10a2: Foodmonger - Home Cooked Foods have an increased selling value based on your cooking level.
[/list]
[*]Level 5b: Foodie - Buff durations from foods last longer (duration based on cooking level)[list]
[*]Level 10b1: Eqicure - Food buffs are one level stronger (+16 for energy or magnetism)
[*]Level 10b2: Gastronomist - Eating or Drinking gives a Third "Food/Drink" buff that has a random effect.
[/list]
[/list][/size][size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2tjtjDL.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Base exp gained from Cooking: Default 2
[*]Bonus exp gained from the Edibility of an item: Default: 50%
[*]Bonus exp Limit: 11
[*]Vanilla food changes: Turn off all but the pie crust changes to vanilla food.
[*]Foodmonger food selling bonus: adjust the value of the sell bonus foodmonger gives to food items that you cook.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Eg7jJbF.png[/img]
[list]
[*]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/174]All Professions[/url]: All spacecore skills are already compatible with all professions.﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11115]Better Crafting[/url]﻿: Has built in support for better crafting through the API!
[*]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]﻿: With the switch to content patcher, all items should correctly show up with the item patcher.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/569]Skill Prestige[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22279]Kitchen Stations[/url]
[*]Mastery (vanilla mastery): Yet another Cooking skill does not have any mastery, but exp gained from YACS will contribute to mastery levels after the player unlocks it.﻿
[*][size=3][url=https://github.com/Annosz/UIInfoSuite2/releases]UI infosuite 2[/url]: Does not support custom skills, you will not see custom skill exp gained from it. Please use one of the other options below...[/size].
[list]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11089]Xp Display[/url]: Will show custom archaeology gained exp. This mod also has custom hooks into it's API to make it so the Hoe and Pan count as Archaeology tools.﻿
[*]﻿﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22751]Abilities - Experience Bars[/url]﻿: Will show custom skills exp gain and show them as bars.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/509]Experience Bars[/url]﻿: Should be compatible with all custom skills
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Look Up Anything[/url]: If you F1 your farmer, you can see exp needed to the next level﻿
[/list][/list][/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dMGE7uv.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Better Gift tastes for cross-mod content. I currently have get tastes set for RSV and SVE, but they are just "default". I plan on going through and adding some more personalized gift tastes.
[*]A rework of Vanilla foods. A lot of foods are eh, so I plan on adding buffs to them.
[*]A big machine! The easy bake oven: Allows you to cook pies overnight and even if you don't have the recipe for them yet. 
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/NaNmbIk.png[/img]
[list]
[*]You can find the [url=https://github.com/Pet-Slime/StardewValley/tree/master/CookingSkillRedux]github here[/url]﻿﻿ to open pull requests
[*]If you want to help out with making the skill better, please do! I will accept most pull requests if you want to help with like optimizing the code, translations, or bug fixes.
[/list]
[/size] [i][size=5][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/SkgptFd.png[/img][/size][/size][/i][i][size=5]
[/size][/i][size=3]Install required mods[i].
[/i]Download, unzip, and place the CookingSkill folder into the Stardew Valley Mod folder.
If installed on an existing file, the new professions should be immediately available.[/size]
Should be compatible with most other mods.  Please share incompatible mods on Nexus.
Not compatible with Android.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PYiimss.png[/img]
